rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for pretending to have virtues, beliefs, or standards that one does not really have.

example.english: They always claim to value integrity, but secretly accept bribes; it is pure hypocrisy.
example.traditional: 佢成日話自己最重視廉潔，背後卻收人利是，真係偽善。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 zeoi3 zung6 si6 lim4 git3 bui3 hau6 koek3 sau1 jan4 lai6 si6 zan1 hai6 ngai6 sin6

rows.note: Use this for conspicuous moral or religious pretence, especially when someone puts on a show of kindness or righteousness.

example.english: They pretend to be kind in front of everyone and then turn around and curse people; what hypocrisy.
example.traditional: 佢喺人面前扮到好有愛心，轉個頭就鬧人，真係假仁假義。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 jan4 min6 cin4 baan6 dou3 hou2 jau5 oi3 sam1 zyun2 go3 tau4 zau6 naau6 jan4 zan1 hai6 gaa2 jan4 gaa2 ji6

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone applies one rule to others but a different rule to themselves.

example.english: They insist that others must not be late while always arriving late themselves; this hypocrisy is really irritating.
example.traditional: 佢要求人哋唔准遲到，自己就成日遲到，呢種雙重標準真係令人反感。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jiu3 kau4 jan4 dei6 m4 zeon2 ci4 dou3 zi6 gei2 zau6 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 ni1 zung2 soeng1 cung4 biu1 zeon2 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 faan2 gam2
